info.name: BOTG API v1.3.0
info.description:
Custom REST API layer for BOTG — hotels, products, and more.

Set the `baseUrl` collection variable to your environment (e.g. `http://localhost:8055` for local).
Set `apiKey` to your Bearer token.

**v1.3.0** — tours/excursions/vehicles/cruises detail responses were fixed and extended: corrected non-existent `name`/`routes` field bugs on tours and excursions, added departure dates/routes/specials to both, wired excursions' authoritative `from_price`, added `camper_specs` to vehicles, and wired the real cruises price matrix (`categories`) plus two cruises field-name bugs. See `directus/extensions/api/CHANGES_2026-07-28_tours-excursions-vehicles-cruises.md` for full details.

variable.description: Base URL of the Directus instance. Override per environment.
Bearer token — value from global_configurations where entity = botg-api-user-key.

request.description:
Returns full hotel detail. The `id` path parameter accepts a UUID, numeric object_id, or px_source_id.

Full response includes: name, season, object_id, status, hotel_group, address, contact, partner_filter_ids, supplier, accommodation_type, classification, activities, translations (descriptions + price info), rooms (categories + prices), price_options (surcharges), specials, image_badge, pictures.

request.description: Returns full cruise detail. Note: cruises has no structured surcharges collection (only a free-text surcharges field under price info). `price_settings`/`from_price` is a per-market settings row (like hotels' hotel_prices), while the actual per-cabin_category x price_date x occupancy price matrix (buy_price only, no sell price wired yet) is now exposed separately as `categories[]` (same grouped shape as tours/excursions). id accepts the internal numeric id or the legacy px_source_id.

date_updated | -date_updated | object_id | -object_id | season | -season (name is not sortable — tours has no top-level name field, only a per-language translation)

request.description: Returns a minimal paginated list of tours (daytrips) — only id, object_id, name, and date_updated. name is resolved from descriptions_translations.name_tour (tours has no top-level name field).

query.description: ISO 639-1 code (de | en | nl | de-CH). If set, all translations blocks return only that language key.

request.description:
Returns full tour detail. id accepts the internal numeric id or the legacy px_source_id. Now includes routes[] (departure/arrival places), departure_dates[] + dates_translations (available_from/to, trip_duration, departure text), and specials_translations (previously all unwired).

NOTE: categories[].prices[].occupancies{}.sell and from_price are always null — tours' pricing schema currently only stores buy_price, with no sell-price field/translation wired yet on directus-dev.

request.description: Returns a minimal paginated list of excursions — only id, object_id, name, and date_updated. name is resolved from descriptions_translations.name_excursion (excursions has no top-level name field; a previous bug meant name was always null — now fixed).

query.description: ISO 639-1 code (de | en | nl | de-CH). If set, all translations blocks return only that language key.

request.description: Returns full excursion detail, including categories[].prices[].occupancies{}.sell and from_price (excursions has a real sell-price translation junction, unlike tours). from_price now prefers the authoritative value stored on price_calculation_translations (exposed as price_settings), falling back to the computed minimum sell price only if that hasn't been set yet. Also now includes routes[], departure_dates[] + dates_translations, specials_translations, and localized category names (previously all unwired). id accepts the internal numeric id or the legacy px_source_id.

request.description: Returns a minimal paginated list of rental vehicles (cars/campers) — only id, object_id, name, and date_updated.

query.description: ISO 639-1 code (de | en | nl | de-CH). If set, all translations blocks return only that language key.

request.description: Returns full vehicle detail. pricing is always { available: false, reason: "..." } — vehicles_prices/vehicles_price_calculation/vehicles_surcharges exist in the schema but have no foreign key back to vehicles yet on directus-dev, so pricing cannot be resolved per vehicle until that schema work lands. Now includes camper_specs (berths, dimensions, fuel/tank capacities, beds, highlights, rating, equipment list) for rental_type=camper vehicles — null for cars. id accepts the internal numeric id or the legacy px_source_id.
Returns the full OpenAPI 3.0 specification as JSON.
